description: Test questions designed to differentiate between RAG levels. Each question includes what level features help answer it and a reference answer.

questions.question: What are the steps to restart a NovaCluster?
questions.why: Basic semantic retrieval. Level 0 should find section 2. Level 5 (full context) also contains it if within first 3000 chars.
questions.reference_answer: Drain worker nodes with kubectl drain, stop control plane with novactl stop, verify pods terminated, start control plane with novactl start, uncordon worker nodes, verify health with novactl health-check.

questions.question: What does error code ERR-003 mean?
questions.why: Exact term match 'ERR-003'. Dense vector search (level 0) may miss the exact code. Hybrid (level 1) with BM25 catches it. Parent-child (level 2) helps because the error code table row may be split across chunks.
questions.reference_answer: ERR-003 means health check failure. Resolution: review control plane logs in /var/log/nova/.

questions.question: What should you do if you encounter ERR-003 during step 6 of the restart?
questions.why: Requires connecting ERR-003 (in table) with step 6 of restart procedure (in text). Parent-child retrieval returns the parent chunk containing both the table and surrounding text, giving the model full context.
questions.reference_answer: Check the control plane logs before proceeding. A failed health check usually indicates a misconfigured network policy.

questions.question: How do you renew certificates before they expire?
questions.why: Direct semantic match. Level 0 should find section 4.2.
questions.reference_answer: Run novactl cert-renew --all-nodes before the 90-day expiry.

questions.question: Which node types support GPU workloads?
questions.why: Exact term 'GPU' and 'worker-gpu'. BM25 keyword search (level 1) catches this reliably.
questions.reference_answer: worker-gpu: 8 vCPU, 32 GB RAM, 1x NVIDIA A100.

questions.question: How long does a full cluster restart typically take?
What security group is applied to new nodes by default?
questions.why: Exact term 'security group' and 'nova-default-sg'. Keyword search helps.
questions.reference_answer: nova-default-sg (allows inbound SSH on port 22 and HTTPS on port 443 only).

questions.question: What happens if certificates expire completely?
questions.why: Semantic retrieval from section 4.2. Level 5 baseline may or may not include this depending on where it falls in the first 3000 chars.
questions.reference_answer: The cluster becomes unreachable and manual intervention is required.

questions.question: What command drains worker nodes before a restart?
questions.why: Direct command lookup. Level 0 should find it.

questions.question: How do you modify security rules for existing nodes?
questions.why: Requires connecting novactl sg apply command with the note that existing nodes require a restart. Parent context helps connect the command to its effect.
questions.reference_answer: Edit /etc/nova/security-groups.conf, run novactl sg apply --config /etc/nova/security-groups.conf, then restart existing nodes to pick up new rules.
